title: Earned settlement: Decision time
summary: The announcement follows nearly a year of consultation over the shape of the ‘earned settlement’ reforms. In its original proposal, the Home Office said that it wanted to lengthen the time that people must live in the UK before they can apply for indefinite leave to remain (ILR) from five years to a default of 10 years…
